sqlite:
CREATE TABLE pc_atomic_memory_evidence_schema (
	schema_version VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (schema_version)
)

CREATE TABLE pc_atomic_memory_evidence_history (
	scope_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	artifact_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	revision BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	sources BLOB NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (scope_id, artifact_id, revision), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_atomic_memory_evidence_history_revision CHECK (revision > 0)
)

CREATE TABLE pc_source_evidence_bindings (
	scope_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	source_type VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	source_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	material_digest VARCHAR(71) NOT NULL, 
	definition_name TEXT NOT NULL, 
	definition_version TEXT NOT NULL, 
	manifest_fingerprint VARCHAR(71), 
	declaration BLOB NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (scope_id, source_type, source_id)
)
